brand.name: FLUXD
brand.positioning: For intellectually curious viewers tired of shallow pop-science and plot summaries, FLUXD is the investigative video journal that braids daily cinema craft, M.Sc.-level physics rigor, geopolitics, and street-level Indian & global socio-economics into visceral visual stories.
brand.tagline: Where Cinema Optics, Physical Law, and Global Systems Collide.

surface_light.name: Silver-Halide Paper
surface_light.job: Warm archival cellulose paper background for mixed-media cutouts, carousel cards, and editorial typography.

surface_dark.name: Anamorphic Carbon Ink
surface_dark.job: Deep optical barrel black-blue for 16:9 YouTube dark telemetry scenes, 3Blue1Brown math stages, and primary body ink.

signature.name: Kodak Halation Vermilion
signature.job: Inspired by 35mm tungsten film halation and red-border investigative highlights. Drives immediate thumbnail and avatar recognition.

secondary.name: Cherenkov Deep Slate
secondary.job: High-density astrophysical & maritime slate for data containers, secondary bars, and geopolitical map overlays.

accent.name: Oscilloscope Amber
accent.job: High-luminance phase-space trajectory and equation highlight locked strictly to Anamorphic Carbon Ink dark surfaces (8.95:1).

muted_neutral.name: Frame-Line Pewter
muted_neutral.job: Calibrated neutral passing 6.64:1 AA/AAA on Silver-Halide Paper for RBI/MOSPI/NASA source citations and gridlines.
